renderer_fix.resolved_issue: H103 .30m-long sheet was clipped by fixed .24m top field and oblique fields; current-state-only symmetric expansion preserves world origin and physical board labels

parent_owned_preflight_items: Resolve ordered-motion instruction versus precrease artifact contract
Disclose 600 integration-frame capability limit and recovery rules in the shared policy
Use actual catalog suite in frozen plan metadata

difficulty_recommendation.first_round_candidate_threshold: At most one of three requested models succeeds on a task, with at least two demonstrably non-environment, non-interface-contaminated failures
difficulty_recommendation.single_round_scope: Development calibration, not a stable success probability or model ranking
secondary_diagnostics: required signed hinge and band coverage

attribution_rules.diagram_error: Wrong intended crease, mountain/valley, scope or omitted depicted precrease demonstrated by the action and source image
attribution_rules.coordinate_or_pose_error: Intended source construction understood but mapped into wrong current board location/orientation; do not infer this from final score alone
attribution_rules.control_planning_or_budget: Loops, undo, premature finish, unsupported large moving packet after disclosed limits; report separately from visual reading
attribution_rules.harness_or_environment: Clipped observation, mismatched source/state/signature, unknown physics, provider errors, timeout, spend-cap stop or missing grading evidence; cannot establish semantic difficulty

limits: Retained directed crease history is not an exact final plastic CP field
Reference accepted paths prove existence inside the supported controller, not all legal paper motions
Provider model IDs do not authenticate model weights
Two tasks and one run per model are not enough to establish stable frontier difficulty
